title: Fendi Sean - We On!
htmlContent:
Fendi Sean shares a new track called "We On!". "We On!" is a smooth, catchy, R&B vibe type song. It’s about taking over the city you reside in and putting it on. Fendi Sean is a newcomer to music creation. His sounds speak against that fact he has a way with music that you can’t quite put into words. You have to listen to it to experience it. And once you do, you start seeing him in a different light. Then you start to realize why people are now starting to notice his talents and skill.

Fendi Sean doesn’t waste a single second on his new record “We On!”. The production is infectious and sets the tone for an exciting display of music. He steps up with the upmost confidence and has a presence that can’t be ignored.
